hints.title: Monotonic Inorder BST Order
hints.text: An inorder traversal of a BST yields values in sorted non-decreasing order.

hints.title: Running Frequency Stream
hints.text: Because identical keys appear contiguously during inorder traversal, streak lengths can be counted sequentially without a dictionary.

hints.title: Streak Counting and Reset
hints.text: Track curr_val, curr_count, and max_count. When current node value equals curr_val, increment count; else reset count to 1. If count exceeds max_count, clear result array with new mode. If count equals max_count, append mode.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Single pass inorder traversal collecting modes without extra hash map.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Collecting all values into a frequency table requires O(N) extra memory space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Contiguous inorder values enable streaming mode tracking in O(H) recursion space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Exploit BST sorted inorder property to find modes without a hash map.
